overall_goal: Prepare, season, and roast the sweet potatoes.

goals.rationale: The person brings the sweet potato to the sink, rinses it under running water, and places it on the chopping board.
The person uses a serrated knife to trim the ends and saw the skin off the sweet potato.

goals.description: Chop the sweet potato into bite-sized pieces.
goals.rationale: The person cuts the peeled sweet potato into smaller, bite-sized chunks.

goals.description: Transfer the chopped sweet potato to a bowl.
goals.rationale: The person retrieves a bowl, places it on a scale, and scoops the chopped sweet potato into it.

goals.description: Retrieve and prepare the baking tray.
goals.rationale: The person takes a baking tray out of a drawer and sets it on the chopping board.

goals.description: Measure and add olive oil to the sweet potatoes.
goals.rationale: The person selects a measuring spoon and pours olive oil over the sweet potatoes in the bowl.

goals.description: Add cumin and chili powder to the sweet potatoes.
goals.rationale: The person finds the correct spice jars and measures cumin and chili powder into the bowl.

goals.description: Mix the sweet potatoes with the seasonings and transfer them to the baking tray.
goals.rationale: The person stirs the sweet potatoes to coat them in oil and spices, then pours the mixture onto the baking tray and spreads it out.

goals.description: Place the baking tray in the oven to roast.
goals.rationale: The person carries the baking tray to the oven and places it inside to roast.
